entries.title: Random hostile encounter: Orc Marauder
entries.text:
A Orc Marauder bursts from cover at the Burning Farmstead and lunges for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
Goal: Defeat or drive off the Orc Marauder.

log: Opening attack.
You use Greatsword: d20 [12] (normal) + 3 Strength + 2 proficiency = 17 vs AC 13. Hit.
8 slashing damage (2 + 3 +3).
Your initiative: d20 [13] + 1 = 14.
Orc Marauder initiative: d20 10 + 1 = 11.
Turn order: You → Orc Marauder.
Round 1 begins.
Your turn.

story.title: Random hostile encounter: Orc Marauder
story.premise: A combat test: a Orc Marauder ambushes Kara Vell at the Burning Farmstead while travelling with a small caravan.
story.opening: A Orc Marauder bursts from cover at the Burning Farmstead and lunges for you. It hasn't closed the gap yet — you have the first move. Describe your attack, spell or other action.
story.objective: Defeat or drive off the Orc Marauder.
story.resolution: Every attacker is defeated, or the player escapes and regroups at the caravan camp.
story.secret: There is no hidden twist; this is a straightforward combat test encounter.
story.foeAppearance: A broad-shouldered grey-green orc with a shaved scalp, jutting lower tusks and a scarred lip, wearing scavenged ring mail and a wolf-pelt mantle. It swings a heavy notched greataxe.

inn.name: Caravan Camp
inn.description: A ring of covered wagons around a smoky campfire, a short walk back along the road.

bridge.name: Burning Farmstead
bridge.description: A farmhouse yard lit by a smouldering barn, with a broken fence and scattered livestock pens.

tower.name: Lookout Rock
tower.description: A lichen-covered boulder above the road with a clear view of the surrounding country.

keeper.name: Captain Oona Brask
keeper.role: Caravan guard captain who hired the player as an escort.
keeper.motive: Get the wagons through safely and pay out only for honest work.
keeper.appearance: A stocky middle-aged dwarf woman with a thick copper-red braid over one shoulder, weathered tan skin, a dented steel cap and a green caravan tabard over chain mail. A ledger hangs from her belt.
keeper.personality: Blunt, dry-humoured and practical; speaks in short clipped sentences.

ties.note: Took Tobin on as a favour to his late mother and quietly looks out for him.

mara.name: Tobin Reed
mara.motive: Prove himself useful to the captain without getting anyone hurt.
mara.appearance: A slight young halfling man with unruly sandy hair, freckles, a patched brown cloak, a sling at his hip and a wooden spoon tucked behind one ear.
mara.personality: Eager, talkative and a little nervous; jokes when frightened.

ties.note: Idolises the captain, who gave him his first real job.

inn.name: Caravan Camp
inn.description: A ring of covered wagons around a smoky campfire, a short walk back along the road.

bridge.name: Trampled Orchard
bridge.description: An abandoned orchard of gnarled apple trees, the ground torn up by heavy hooves.

tower.name: Lookout Rock
tower.description: A lichen-covered boulder above the road with a clear view of the surrounding country.

keeper.name: Captain Oona Brask
keeper.role: Caravan guard captain who hired the player as an escort.
keeper.motive: Get the wagons through safely and pay out only for honest work.
keeper.appearance: A stocky middle-aged dwarf woman with a thick copper-red braid over one shoulder, weathered tan skin, a dented steel cap and a green caravan tabard over chain mail. A ledger hangs from her belt.
keeper.personality: Blunt, dry-humoured and practical; speaks in short clipped sentences.

ties.note: Took Tobin on as a favour to his late mother and quietly looks out for him.

mara.name: Tobin Reed
mara.motive: Prove himself useful to the captain without getting anyone hurt.
mara.appearance: A slight young halfling man with unruly sandy hair, freckles, a patched brown cloak, a sling at his hip and a wooden spoon tucked behind one ear.
mara.personality: Eager, talkative and a little nervous; jokes when frightened.

ties.note: Idolises the captain, who gave him his first real job.

keeper.appearance: A stocky middle-aged dwarf woman with a thick copper-red braid over one shoulder, weathered tan skin, a dented steel cap and a green caravan tabard over chain mail. A ledger hangs from her belt.
keeper.personality: Blunt, dry-humoured and practical; speaks in short clipped sentences.

ties.note: Took Tobin on as a favour to his late mother and quietly looks out for him.

mara.name: Tobin Reed
mara.motive: Prove himself useful to the captain without getting anyone hurt.
mara.appearance: A slight young halfling man with unruly sandy hair, freckles, a patched brown cloak, a sling at his hip and a wooden spoon tucked behind one ear.
mara.personality: Eager, talkative and a little nervous; jokes when frightened.

ties.note: Idolises the captain, who gave him his first real job.

story.title: The Glass Orchard
story.premise: The harvest remembers a vanished storm.
story.opening: An orchard worker asks you to examine singing fruit.
story.objective: Discover why the trees are singing.
story.resolution: Find the buried bell and persuade the workers to silence it.
story.secret: A storm bell lies under the roots.
